title: I Put the Missing-Sourdough Photo on the Fridge They Moderated

parts.text: I opened the staff fridge at 7:12 a.m. and my labeled starter was gone. Tess from ops moderated the fridge board and laughed that culture was communal. I was twenty-nine, baker on staff, holding a jar lid that still said MY NAME. I photographed the empty shelf, the lid, and the board she locked. Then I posted the still on the fridge they moderated. At 7:21 facilities pinged a missing labeled jar. Tess returned a half-fed starter and a note about sharing. Fridge policy now has a second line: LABELS ARE NOT COMMUNAL. I keep a spare lid in my locker. The fridge finally looks like a shelf, not a potluck.

social.video_title: They called my labeled starter communal — Part 1/1
social.description: Empty shelf, a locked fridge board, a lid with my name. Would you have posted the still?
